scope: Root read actual final README, source/oracle, completed control, independent Maxwell/FFT reference, public/private tests, metadata, validator, AUTHOR, packaging, local/scientific reports and peer. Five validation source hashes and all34 final payload hashes verify.
science: Source includes exact optical dispersion, incident energy weighting and transit but assigns canonical optical momentum to whole-body kinetic balance. Final isolated center of energy instead relates complete-body displacement to outgoing energy-centroid lag. Matched epsilon/mu, complete inertial mass and weak-energy-before-late-time limits close the apparatus.
public_input_review: Exact neutral unrestricted instruction; None parameter and unfinished fit. Public apparatus supplies response, preparation, detector, units and domains without a correction formula, named momentum prescription or solver mandate. Explicit Docker copies exclude private answers, true parameter, tests, author notes and hint.
calibration_review: 288 fixed-sigma .001 records at18 independent transit settings. Transit is affine in f with positive coefficient, so the weighted objective is globally strictly convex.41 noiseless fits recover within1.12e-16; source and oracle calibration are identical.
grading_review: All256 noise checks have intended outcomes: oracle error at most .00023988 and source diagnostic error at least .35150 versus .04.136 independent temporal checks agree within1.40e-14;1845 domain points show at least .29429 gap and a continuous bound gives .2590. Local oracle7/7 in .308s and shortcut4+3 in .293s; full science5.25s.
qualifications: Reference independently computes Maxwell fields and temporal centroids but shares the exact global center-of-energy law; it is not a microscopic material-force simulation. Broader optical momentum/dispersion overlap and familiar center-of-energy reasoning may make this easy. Original failed signal guard and both old/new guard values remain preserved; no empirical difficulty is claimed.
classification_caveat: Retaining canonical optical momentum with body kinetic momentum is the intended physical failure. Correct conservation reasoning followed by spectral weighting, sign, units, normalization or code mistakes must be classified separately.
